claude.sample_unit: patients (cervical cancer VMAT plans; 200 routine + 21 added-criteria cases)

links.outcome: Effect of local tuning (transfer learning, MDN, prediction tolerance) on dose prediction for new criteria
links.effect: Original model M_A performed poorly on Dataset B; calibrated approaches (transfer learning, MDN, PT) reduced femoral head dose in line with new criteria and produced feasible plans.
links.quote: Table 6 shows that M A has a small error with Dataset A but performs poorly on Dataset B, indicating the importance of adapting to the criteria.

links.outcome: Femoral head dose in generated plans
links.effect: On Dataset B, Femoral Head L/R Dmean differences were 24.30%±27.36%/26.42%±29.36% with M A versus -16.38%±16.27%/-12.52%±18.80% with M B.
links.quote: As shown in Appendix Fig. 1 , the employment of calibrated methods resulted in a notable reduction in the dosage of Femoral Heads.

links.effect: On Dataset B generated plans, non-calibrated M A had Femoral Head L/R Dmean differences of 24.30%±27.36% and 26.42%±29.36% versus clinical plans.
links.quote: Table 6 shows that M A has a small error with Dataset A but performs poorly on Dataset B, indicating the importance of adapting to the criteria.

links.effect: PCTV Dmax errors included -2.09%±0.51% (MDN A) and 3.71%±0.33% (MDN B); Spinal Cord D0.1 cc errors reached 40.70%±47.40% (M t).
links.quote: Additionally, the prediction of point indexes such as Dmax and D0.01 cc are not accurate enough for all methods, while other indexes besides those mentioned above are acceptable, with MAE mostly less than 5%.

links.outcome: femoral head dose reduction and criteria compliance in auto-planning
links.effect: All calibration approaches significantly reduced femoral head dosage (p < 0.05), adapting pre-existing models to newly added clinical criteria.
links.quote: Additionally, all the calibration approaches significantly reduced the dosage of Femoral Heads ( p < 0.05), but with different planning styles.

screen.practice: local recalibration of dose prediction model before use
screen.reason: Evaluates and compares different model calibration and adjustment strategies (Prediction Tolerance function, transfer learning, and mixture density network) to adapt an existing radiation therapy auto-planning model to specific clinical requirements and data imbalance.
